summary:
### Goal
Fix dunning reminders for already-paid customers, then resume search/Kafka/router work.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small; use module-owned `structlog`, never `print()` or stdlib logging. Webhooks require ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and `@priya`. Execute Kafka migration steps strictly one at a time. Integration jobs must use `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is retired and hangs.

### Key decisions and facts
CSV exporter now explicitly writes UTF-8 and has Unicode regression coverage. Invoice helpers were typed; `build_invoice_lines` now materializes a list, and `calculate_totals` converts discounts to `Decimal`. `post_entry` uses timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Kafka `orders.v2` was confirmed at 12 partitions and partitions 0–11 were reassigned across replicas 1, 2, 3.

### Ruled out
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` index doubled ingest latency. Router split is paused.

### Progress
Full suite: 186 passed, 3 skipped; billing tests: 34 passed. `ruff check`, `compileall`, and `git diff --check` passed. CSV changes remain in `csv_export.py` and `test_csv_export.py`.

### Next steps
Commit CSV fix, inspect `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, add payment-status regression tests/fix, run tests, and continue Kafka from procedure step 7.
per_round:
### Goal
Split monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers; safely migrate Kafka `orders.v1`/6 partitions to `orders.v2`/12. Optimize search rebuilds.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. Never use `print()` or stdlib logging; use owning-module `structlog`. Never create/modify Stripe webhooks without posting the ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and tagging `@priya`. Execute Kafka steps strictly in order, one at a time.

### Key decisions and facts
Webhook retry work is complete: transport/server errors retry; 422 does not. Full suite: 44 passed; Ruff clean.
Search rebuilder now uses tenant-scoped queries, 8-worker ordered embedding, and chunks of 100. A 5,000-invoice rebuild improved from 8.42s to ~1.19–1.87s. Combined index/rebuilder tests: 33 passed. Existing `invoices_tenant_updated_idx` is selected.
Kafka step 1 succeeded: `orders.v1` exists with 6 partitions, replication factor 3.

### Ruled out
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` index doubled ingest write latency.

### Progress
Two webhook files changed: 31 insertions, 4 deletions; no whitespace errors. Search timing and concurrent/chunked embedding changes are implemented. Kafka steps 2–9 remain untouched.

### Next steps
Update remaining tenant migration helper away from per-document embedding; test and commit search work separately. Continue Kafka procedure from step 2. Then begin route decomposition.

### Goal
Fix the dunning scheduler emailing reminders to already-paid customers. Resume search/Kafka/router work afterward.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. Use module-owned `structlog`, never `print()` or stdlib logging. Webhooks require ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and `@priya`. Execute Kafka migration steps strictly one at a time.

### Key decisions and facts
Search rebuild now shares `EmbeddingClient`, bulk-upserts vectors, scopes queries by tenant, embeds in 8-worker order with 100-item chunks, and uses `invoices_tenant_updated_idx`. Added unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` migration `0042`. Full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped. Kafka: `orders.v1` has 6 partitions; consumer group stopped; offsets captured.

### Ruled out
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` index doubled ingest latency. Router split paused.

### Progress
Fixed CSV report encoding to explicit UTF-8 and added Unicode regression coverage; exporter tests 24 passed, Ruff clean. Changes remain in `csv_export.py` and `test_csv_export.py`.

### Next steps
Commit CSV fix. Investigate `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, add regression tests, fix payment-status filtering, and run focused/full tests. Continue Kafka from procedure step 4.
